It added the [[Pizza Party]] rework. This update contains thirteen updates, the main v1.50.0 (released 20 January 2025) and five minor updates, the v1.50.0a (released 22 January 2025), v1.50.0b (released 22 January 2025), v1.50.1 (released 22 January 2025), v1.50.1a (released 23 January 2025), v1.50.2 (released 26 January 2025), v1.50.3 (released 28 January 2025), v1.50.4 (released 28 January 2025), v1.50.5 (released 28 ****Damage increased from +26 to +36. ****Cost decreased from {{Money|3,500}} to {{Money|3,250}}. ***'''Level 4''' ****Damage decreased from +70 to +60. ****Cluster bomb damage decreased from 40x4 to *[[Necromancer]] buffed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Level 2''' ****[[Sword Skeleton]] damage increased from 15 to 20. ***'''Level 3''' ****Damage increased from +8 to +18. ****Soul Meter changed from +224 to +354. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|48,000}} to {{Money|44,000}}. ****Base damage decreased from -5 to -10. ****Soul Meter changed from +1,120 to +990. ===Enemies=== *[[Abnormal]] health increased from 6 to 8 in [[Pizza Party]]. *[[Quick]] health increased from 6 to 10 in [[Pizza Party]]. *[[Heavy]] health increased from 16 to 45 in [[Pizza Party]]. *[[Scout (Pizza Party)|Scout]] changed. **Health increased from 300 to 400. **Speed increased from Average (3) to Above Average (3.5). **Now gives {{Money|400}} upon death. *[[Breaker2]] health increased from 50 to 100 in [[Pizza Party]]. *[[Breaker]] health increased from 20 to 50 in [[Pizza Party]]. *[[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]] changed. **Health increased from 2,000 to 2,500. **Speed slightly increased from 2 to 2.1. **Defense decreased from 40% to 30%. **Now gives {{Money|1,000}} every 50% health lost. **[[Freeze Immunity]] added. *[[Monkey]] changed. **Health changed from 250 to 800 **Speed decreased from Fast (6) to Below Average (2.5) **Defense of 50% added. **Now gives {{Money|800}} on death. **[[Aggro]] added. *[[Commander (Pizza Party)|Commander]] now gives {{Money|2,000}} every 25% health lost. *[[Balloon Kid]] changed. **Health increased from 225 to 500. **[[Shield Health]] of 750 added. **Speed increased from 3.5 to 4. **Now gives {{Money|1,250}} on death. *[[Minigunner (Pizza Party)|Minigunner]] changed. **Health increased from 14,000 to 30,000. **Speed icnreased from Slightly Slow (2) to Below Average (2.5). **Defense increased from 20% to 30%. **Now gives {{Money|3,000}} every 10% health lost. *[[Mimic Umbra]] changed. **Health increased from 9,000 to 16,000. **Speed increased from 3.5 to 4. **Defense decreased from 35% to 25%. **Now gives {{Money|4,000}} every 25% health lost. **[[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]] added. **[[Burn Immunity]] added. **[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. *[[Wox the Fox]] changed. **Health increased from 250,000 to 450,000. **Now gives {{Money|4,500}} every 1% health lost. *Fixed [[Super Slime|Radioactive Slime]] using the wrong icon in the [[Index]]. *Fixed [[Dummy Boss]] using the wrong icon. ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Pizza Party]] updated. **Wave structure changed. **Now moved over to its own mode instead of using the [[Challenge Maps]] system to alter legacy [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. **Updated rewards. **Now uses the new income system. **Health scaling added. **Mode type is now displayed as ''Special''. **[[Mutation]] increase per wave decreased from 10% to 6%. *[[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]] can now be applied to enemies and units in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *Updated loading screen to use the [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] as background. *Fixed [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode Admin Mode not granting any of the benefits when given to other players, though enemies are still not fully unlocked when given. *Fixed kicking in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode not working. *Fixed blacklisting in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode not working. *Fixed multiple map modifiers, such as [[All Paths]] or [[Scuba Gear]], not appearing in the bottom left corner. *Fixed towers in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode not being selectable if the player's loadout was forcibly changed by a [[Challenge Maps|Challenge Map]] *Fixed modes not ending properly after triumphing them in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *Fixed [[Lost Souls]] saturation breaking when applied multiple times in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *Fixed "Data" rarely showing up as a map
